Experience

STEI - ITB

Research Assistant - Collision Avoidance System Development For Mining

February 2023 - June 2023

As a Research Assistant in the development of a Collision Avoidance System for mining operations, I was responsible for designing an advanced system aimed at enhancing safety within the mining environment. This involved creating system specifications, developing algorithms for object detection and tracking, and ensuring the design met the unique challenges of the mining industry. My work contributed to the overall goal of minimizing collision risks and improving operational efficiency in complex mining scenarios.

STEI - ITB

Research Assistant - Autonomous Tram Development Using Artificial Intelligence

January 2021 - April 2023

As a Research Assistant, I developed a modified LiDAR-based 3D object detection system tailored for implementation in mixed traffic conditions in Indonesia. My work involved implementing the deep learning model on an embedded computer, ensuring efficient processing and real-time performance. Additionally, I integrated the model with various modules and the tram’s drive-by-wire system, contributing to enhanced navigation and safety in urban environments.
